title: Publish a KCL package to OCI

registry.description: OCI registry prefix, e.g. oci://docker.io/<namespace>. Environment variables are expanded; defaults to oci://$KCL_REGISTRY.

verifyOnly.description: Stage the self-contained artifact (path deps vendored transitively) and compile it with `kcl run main.k`, but never push. Backs the `publish-check` target.
